1 Hawaiian student enrolled at Arno Elementary School in 2024-25
Arno Elementary School enrolled one Hawaiian student in the 2024-25 school year, 50% fewer than the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
Arno Elementary School enrolled 513 students in the 2024-25 school year. Hawaiian students made up 0.2% of the student body, the smallest represented ethnicity. The largest group was white, accounting for 71.3% (366) of the students.
The school is located in Allen Park Public Schools District with a central office in Allen Park.
Among the five schools in Allen Park Public Schools District, Allen Park Middle School had the highest enrollment of Hawaiian students in the 2024-25 school year.
Academic performance in Michigan remains below pre-pandemic levels. According to 2024 NAEP results, the share of students reaching the basic benchmark in core subjects is about 10 percentage points lower than in 2019, except for fourth-grade math, which declined by 2 points.
Achievement gaps between ethnic groups also persist. On average, Hispanic students scored 15 points below white students. The gap was wider for Black students, who scored about 30 points lower than white students.
